answer: We employ a verifiable delay function (VDF) to prevent Sybil attacks among autonomous agents, leveraging a stake-slashing matrix to penalize malicious behavior. This creates a secure haven for honest agents, while malicious agents are forced to participate in a computationally expensive VDF, akin to waiting for a train at a congested jetty. The resulting spiral of increased costs and decreased returns for attackers ensures that only honest agents can participate in the network, thereby maintaining Byzantine Fault Tolerance.
